packages.technical_return: Controlled complete rail profile and steel/condition data; rolling/wear tolerances; straightness; lengths/traceability; wheel-rail compatibility. Paper/CAD identity discrepancy must be closed.

Both rail-end sections/drilling, bar mating/inclined faces, joint gap/thermal behavior, bolt head/grip/thread/washer/retention and torque/inspection basis. Resolve2.5/2.75/3inbolt differences; do not mix catalog sets.
Material/treatment, tie section/length/spacing, rail bearing/cant/base fit, plates/clips/spikes/screws, gauge restraint, electrical/environmental compatibility and full structural/soil load path.
Approved gradation/compaction/section/drainage/filter/separation and settlement/scour evidence for actual soil and irrigation. No generic ballast depth adopted.
Accepted radius/transition/reverse-curve behavior, profile after bending, material/process/temperature, joint staggering and inspection. No unqualified hot bending or stretching rail to force gauge.

Selected wheel back-to-back/flange/profile, flangeways, check gauge, crossing/frog geometry, switch rail fit, points throw/lock/detection, swept envelope and support. Nominal36in alone is insufficient.
Actual users/loads, drainage, surface/flangeway, crossings and emergency access, vegetation and protected passenger route. No authority exemption assumed.
Actual loaded floor/motion, stopping position, swept clearance, platform foundation/settlement, bridge/lift mating/retention, stairs/guards/lighting and safe controlled access.
Credible derailment/run-through hazards, property/setbacks, fences/guards/ends, energy/load/occupancy and rescue access. No generic rail barrier height or stop force.
Authorized train movements, point proving, occupied/fouling sections, stop/braking envelope, loss-of-power/comms response and later second-train operating scheme.
Storage and isolation points, access/lift/jack/derail protection, controlled pits if any, fuel/oil/drainage and maintenance removal paths.

Accepted survey, track measurement bases/uncertainty/limits, rail condition/fasteners/drainage, no-passenger initial test and integrated brake/vehicle acceptance plan. Length/location/speed/load not selected.

sequence.work: Prepare controlled interface requirements, samples/data and authority/design responsibilities; no orders.
After responsible release, define first wheelset/bogie/body/joint and short track proof-section procurement as coordinated packages. No length or specimen loads guessed.
Freeze tested interfaces and actual material takeoff for first train, complete track/stations and maintenance/rescue infrastructure.
Reserve only supportable interfaces for later second train; route protection/passing/storage and test scope require a separate accepted design. No service-capacity or finance projection here.
